repos_data.description: zerocode-tdd is a community-developed, free, open-source, automated testing lib for microservices APIs, Kafka(Data Streams), Databases and Load testing. It enables you to create executable automated test scenarios via simple JSON or YAML — no coding required.
This generic SOAP client allows you to access web services using a your iOS app, Mac OS X app and AppleTV app.
Generates a PHP SDK based on a WSDL, simple and powerful, WSDL to PHP
High-performance, multi-protocol mock server. HTTP, WebSocket, gRPC, MQTT, SSE, GraphQL, SOAP in one binary.
